description: With Support Fading for Johnson, Tina Positioned to Make Further Gains Among Democrats [Portland, OR] – The Democratic candidate for Governor, Tina Kotek, is holding a two-point lead (40%) over Republican Christine Drazan (38%), according to new polling conducted by GBAO on behalf of the Tina Kotek campaign.
